source_description: Separate Chennai CMRL metro and MTC bus static GTFS feeds maintained by UngalSoththu.

metrics.scheduled_travel_time: Median scheduled minutes between consecutive CMRL stops derived from stop_times
metrics.first_mile: Straight-line distance from each CMRL station to nearest MTC bus stop
metrics.first_mile_500m: Count of MTC bus stops within 500m straight-line radius
metrics.screening_index: Equal-weight normalized combination of route coverage, inverse nearest-bus-stop distance and 500m bus-stop density; screening only
metrics.network_role: Interchange when a CMRL station is served by more than one CMRL route in the GTFS feed; otherwise Operational
metrics.line: CMRL route_short_name values serving each station, joined when multiple routes serve the stop

limitations: Static GTFS represents scheduled service, not observed traffic or real-time delays.
Straight-line first/last-mile distances are proximity proxies, not pedestrian network travel distance.
The source feeds are community-maintained and are not presented as official CMRL/CUMTA open-data feeds.
